title: The synced folders the person's agents reach, and one folder's entries
description: GET /api/v1/integrations/files with no query lists the browsable roots: each connected account's sync directory under ~/cloud that exists now as the person's own directory. With ?directory=<a root's directory> (and &folder=<a relative folder in it>) the mapped daemon reads that one folder as the person: names, kinds, sizes and modification times, never content. Every level is opened beneath the one above without following a symlink or crossing a mount; a directory that is not one of the roots is directory_unavailable (404) and a folder that does not exist folder_missing (404). Nothing is kept between reads.

entries.description: Subfolders first, then regular files, each by name; at most 500.

truncated.description: The folder holds more than the reply carries.

unlisted.description: Entries left out because they are links, special files or names the reply cannot carry.

bytes.description: A file's size; absent for a folder and an empty file.
